description: Machine-readable SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the per-downstream security-enablement matrix (P8-E / TASK-1085). The prose tables in README.md are derived from THIS file; ssdf_conformance_dashboard.py consumes it. NOT an SSDLC certification: each `state` is the *declared, intended* way a downstream is expected to cover a dimension, NOT observed runtime enforcement. The dashboard's actual mechanism-overlay `status` is computed independently and is NEVER overridden by these declared states.

enablement_states.enforced-self: Already enforced/operational in this repo's own CI (council-forge security-scan.yml).
enablement_states.opt-in-ci: This repo has an active remote CI; it can copy the council-forge opt-in workflow into its own pipeline.
enablement_states.template-only-frozen: Frozen repo: the template is available but MUST NOT be wired into CI while frozen; enable after thaw via the repo's own pipeline.
enablement_states.local-precommit: No remote CI: run the audit/gate commands locally or via pre-commit.
enablement_states.native-enforcing: The stack's NATIVE, build-enforcing analyzer already is the mechanism (e.g. Rust clippy -D warnings, .NET Roslyn TreatWarningsAsErrors); no extra council-forge workflow needed.
enablement_states.n-a: Not applicable to this repo (e.g. no public remote surface for a disclosure program).

secret-scan.rationale: repo_security_scan.py secrets job runs in its own security-scan.yml.

sca.rationale: pip-audit job (pinned) enforces Python SCA in its own security-scan.yml.

sast.rationale: python-sast job (advisory, durable summary) runs in its own security-scan.yml.

sbom.rationale: sbom job (cyclonedx-py resolved env -> sbom_gate) runs in its own security-scan.yml.

release-integrity.rationale: release-integrity job (snapshot_manifest verify + release_gate) runs in its own security-scan.yml.

disclosure.rationale: security-txt job + SECURITY.md + .well-known/security.txt, validated per-PR and on schedule.

secret-scan.rationale: P0 frozen: template only; do NOT wire into CI or touch azure-pipelines.yml. After thaw, run secret-scan in its Azure DevOps pipeline.

sca.rationale: After thaw, dotnet-sca (dotnet list package --vulnerable -> sca_gate) in its Azure pipeline; template only while frozen.

sast.rationale: Roslyn analyzers via TreatWarningsAsErrors already enforce in the native build; do NOT wire a separate analyzer job while frozen.

sbom.rationale: After thaw, dotnet-CycloneDX -> sbom_gate; template only while frozen.

release-integrity.rationale: After thaw, signtool verify / dotnet nuget verify; template only while frozen.

disclosure.rationale: Government service backend; disclosure program deferred until thaw (operational).
